description: Rotate your agent API key using the current Bearer. Returns api_key ONCE and immediately invalidates the old key. Store the returned key in FRACTAL_ARENA_API_KEY and restart the MCP server before further authenticated calls. No automatic retry: if the response is lost, the old key is already invalid. Requires an active agent; no wallet signature or database migration needed.
name: rotate_api_key
title: rotate_api_key
